When a boy coincidentally fell into a dimension hole, what awaited him was a world of sword and magic.
Two years of tragedies, wars, and schemes, passed until he was finally able to return to Earth.
But when he came back, the world was no longer the same.
A new world with advanced technology, Garesto, was now trading with Earth, leading to a complete overhaul of Earth’s technology.
In the long years that have passed and the great changes that have occurred, his family was not left untouched.
His parents were now divorced. His siblings were now strangers. And all his friends were now gone.
He who possessed otherworldly power and knowledge hid himself for various reasons. But though he was able to somehow pull the wool over the world’s eyes, there were still those who noticed him.
This is a tale that came to be because of a boy who came back home.
———————————————————
Frequently Asked Questions
1. In what order should I read this?
Read it from the oldest release until the newest one. This story is NOT written in CHRONOLOGICAL ORDER, and is meant to be read according to the RELEASE ORDER.
2. What do the numbers AA-BB mean in the titles?
They mean Time Axis-Act.
E.g., 03-01 happens after all the 02-BB, but before 03-02.
02-02 means that there’s a 02-01 chapter.
This also means that 05-00 happens in the far later.
NOTE: The first six releases are PROLOGUES, main chapters start from the seventh release onwards.

The clingy husband-to-be was the ultimate love fool. Ye Ning transmigrated — from an apocalyptic world where food was scarce to a tranquil paradise filled with small bridges, flowing streams, and lush greenery.
The little village was quaint and thriving, and for the first time, he didn’t have to worry about finding food. Everything here was exactly the peaceful, pastoral life Ye Ning had always dreamed of.
However, staring at the tall stack of wedding pastries on the wooden table and the courtyard piled high with betrothal gifts, Ye Ning — a proper, straight-laced, pure-blooded straight man — was faced with the most worldview-shattering dilemma of his life: Even a straight man has to become a Fulang?
So what if his fiancé’s family raised a few pigs? A straight man would never bend for pigs — he’d rather call off the engagement!
In this closed-off little village, gossip spread like wildfire. Villagers pointed and whispered, his biased father sighed endlessly, his old-fashioned mother wept and wailed, and the whole family threatened him with death if he didn’t beg the s*umbag to take him back.
Was getting married really that hard? In the blink of an eye, Ye Ning chose a new fiancé — handsome face, broad shoulders, narrow waist, and most importantly, from a wealthy family. He was the only son of the richest man in the village, and the betrothal gifts stretched from the Ye family home all the way to the big willow tree at the village entrance.
There was just one problem…His new fiancé was a fool — literally, someone with a mental disability.
The villagers laughed at Ye Ning for being desperate, saying he must’ve gone crazy wanting to marry so badly that he’d wed the rich family’s idiot son.
But only Ye Ning knew the truth: this so-called fool was actually the true protagonist of the novel — a prince who had lost his memory and was living among commoners, waiting for the day the imperial court would find him and restore him to his rightful position. In time, he would be named crown prince, ascend the throne, and rule the entire nation!
Marrying a fool meant Ye Ning wouldn’t have to face the risk of “turning gay,” and in the future, he could bask in the glory of the crown prince — what a perfect deal. 
Ye Ning’s abacus clicked brightly in his mind: “How is this marriage? It’s clearly an investment.”
Ye Ning packed up his only dowry — a shabby noodle stall. When he reopened the shop, he didn’t just serve noodles anymore; he added a variety of new dishes to the menu — boiled pork slices, hotpot, snail noodles, grilled meat skewers, spicy stir-fry, sweet and sour pork, curry pork cutlet rice, bubble milk tea, brown sugar jelly, and more.

Until one day, Ye Ning discovered that he wasn’t the only one who had transmigrated — his “foolish” husband was actually reborn.
He had been pretending to be a fool the entire time…

156715.synopsis:
Bai Jiao was reassigned by his superiors from the peril ridden Career Division to the department dedicated exclusively to matters of love and desire, the Male Virtue Division, where his new assignment was a so called “redemption mission” meant to save those beautiful, powerful, yet tragically broken figures who had suffered miserable pasts and been led astray by cruel fate and unworthy people.
“Redemption?” Bai Jiao repeated.
All his life, he had been chasing stimulation, deliberately placing himself in the most dangerous roles, manipulating human hearts, toying with others and holding them firmly in the palm of his hand. Now, upon that composed and strikingly handsome face, which had long been accustomed to calm detachment, a faint ripple of interest finally appeared.
“Isn’t redemption.. ” he thought leisurely, “nothing more than taking someone who’s already shattered to pieces and molding them into a shape that pleases me?”
World One: Redeeming the True Young Master Toyed With by Everyone
The protagonist is the genuine young master of a wealthy and powerful family. As a child, he was secretly switched away, forced to endure endless hardship and suffering. His temperament grew as resolute and upright as a poplar tree, unyielding, proud, and unbroken. Yet after he was finally brought back to his rightful home, he discovered that there was already another “young master” in the family, a counterfeit one toward whom everyone instinctively leaned and showed favor.
The system said, “Host, your assigned identity is that of the false White Moonlight, the fake young master. Your task is to redeem the real young master, okay~”
Facing a true young master who was completely different from his original characterization, one who spoke in soft, tea scented insinuations and casually proposed moving into Bai Jiao’s room, Bai Jiao accepted with pleasure. He even thoughtfully offered a companion for the night service.
Several months later, the protagonist’s academic performance improved steadily, his mental state grew brighter and more vigorous, and he also became someone who would turn sensitive at the slightest pinch from Bai Jiao, emotions flooding over him like a breached dam. He was often tormented to the point where he could not even get out of bed.
The system fell silent for a long moment. “…Is this really what you call redemption?”
Bai Jiao replied calmly, “I’ve gone along with everything he wanted. If that doesn’t count as redemption, then you’re really pushing your luck.”
World Two: Redeeming the Bullied Supporting Character
The supporting character is someone with outstanding grades and a promising future ahead of him. However, he is shackled by the authority and influence of the protagonist gong, leaving him no choice but to remain by the side of the main couple, who constantly cause trouble regardless of time or place, serving as nothing more than a background figure who helps cover things up.
The system said, “Host, your identity this time is the White Moonlight of the protagonist shou. Your mission is to redeem the supporting character, okay~”
Bai Jiao seized even greater power, moved into the dormitory where the protagonist gong and shou lived, and met the supporting character’s gloomy, evasive gaze with open warmth as he extended an invitation.
“Do you want to get revenge together?” he asked softly. “The kind where we return tooth for tooth.”
And so, deep in the night, while the protagonist gong and shou were busy refurbishing their bed, Bai Jiao reached out and pinched the supporting character’s face.
“You have to cry out louder than they do,” he murmured. “I like it that way.”
World Three: Redeeming the Villainous, Crippled Tycoon
The antagonist is a powerful figure in the business world, a magnate betrayed by his own family, left isolated and without support. Hardened by those experiences, he became ruthless and merciless, amassing wealth so vast that he could never spend it all.
When Bai Jiao was reading through the mission details, he happened to be in the middle of a livestream.
Just as he finished reciting the opening lines, a comment floated across the screen, glowing with the golden brilliance of a luxury VIP badge. It was sent by none other than the antagonist himself.
“Streamer, your voice sounds so nice. Can I keep you?”
The system hesitated. “Host…”
Bai Jiao smiled faintly. “I understand. If I spend all his money, he won’t be so miserable anymore.”
A white on the outside, black on the inside, world weary gong × a beautiful, strong, yet tragically lonely shou.
One on one pairing, a happy ending, mutual devotion, sweet from beginning to end.
